# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 22 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launches & Private Residential

- **Lentor Gardens Residences sells 270 units at S$2,350 psf average on launch day** - The 499-unit project moved 270 homes on 18 July 2026, a 54% take-up rate, at an average price of about S$2,350 psf. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/lentor-gardens-residences-sells-270-units-at-an-average-of-s2350-psf/)

- **Tan Boon Liat Building sold for $950 million in what may be 2026's biggest en-bloc deal** - Kingsford Havelock Pte Ltd has acquired the freehold Outram Road site, which carries a raised Gross Plot Ratio of 4.9 and could accommodate twin towers of up to 48 storeys. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapores-tan-boon-liat-building-sold-for-950m/)

- **Dunearn House launches as the first private residential project in the new Turf City precinct** - Indicative prices start from S$2,799 psf, with 2-bedroom units from S$1.475 million, positioning it within the broader Bukit Timah and Core Central Region market. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/price-analysis-evaluating-dunearn-house-within-the-wider-bukit-timah-and-ccr/)

## HDB Resale Records

- **4-room flat at MacPherson Spring sets new Geylang record at $1.1 million** - The unit at 82B Circuit Road sold in July 2026, beating the previous Geylang high by $12,000 despite being on a lower floor. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/4-room-hdb-flat-set-a-new-geylang-price-record-at-1-1m/)

- **2-room HDB national resale record broken as Queenstown flat fetches S$696,000** - A high-floor 2-room unit at SkyParc @ Dawson changed hands on 15 July 2026, setting a new national record for the flat type. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/2-room-national-record-broken-as-queenstown-unit-sells-for-s696000/)

## Policy & Market Conditions

- **Singapore lowers qualifying age for senior-friendly public housing** - The policy change could encourage older residents to downsize, potentially freeing up larger HDB flats for the broader resale market. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapore-just-lowered-the-age-for-senior-friendly-public-housing-a-move-that-could-free-up-larger-hdb-flats/)

- **New home sales hit a 2-year low in June, with a rebound expected in July** - Developers sold just 156 private homes excluding ECs in June, a figure partly attributed to the mid-year school holiday period. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/developers-new-home-sales-fall-to-a-2-year-low-in-june-rebound-expected-in-july/)
